name: Duplicate dish

guide.summary: Make an independent copy of the dish with its own name.
guide.biology: A game tool with no lab analogue: no two real cultures are ever exactly alike, but a duplicate starts as an exact copy.
guide.rules: The copy starts with exactly the same organisms, amounts and seed. From then on the two dishes are separate: a change in one never reaches the other. Once they differ, chance events in them can differ too.
guide.example: Duplicate a dish, add Amoebas to the copy only, and see how the Sprinters do in each.

changes: A new, separately named dish is made from this moment.
doesNotChange: The original dish and its saves.
watchFor: Whether the two dishes go different ways after you change one of them.
